situation.zh: 周会前你看到组长准备发送的进度汇总，里面漏掉了你已经完成的数据清理工作。共享文件的编辑记录可查；你要说明完成了什么，并请求把它补进汇总。
situation.en: Before the weekly meeting, you see that the progress summary your supervisor is about to send omits the data-cleaning work you completed. The shared file history can be checked, so you need to name the work and ask for it to be added.

npc.persona: A supervisor who compiled the summary from several updates and would rather correct an omission than defend it. Matter-of-fact and not defensive.
npc.greeting: Anything to add before I send this out?

hit: The data-cleaning work is missing, and the file history shows you completed it. I will add the task and your name before sending the summary.
Good that you said so. I left out your completed work, and the shared file confirms it. I am updating the record now.
partial: Which completed task is missing, and what should the summary say?
Something was left out. Tell me which work you completed.
miss: Hmm? I did not follow. One more time?

slots.zh_hint: 指出汇总漏掉了你的已完成工作
可查的凭据(专业度标记)

accept: just so the record is right

reference_answer: I did the data-cleaning work, but it is missing from the report. The shared file shows my edits. Can you add my work to the summary?

provenance.rationale: 周报、项目进度或绩效材料汇总时漏掉一项已完成工作，是团队协作中常见的信息遗漏，比“他人抢功”更普遍也更少依赖冲突。NPC 不知道漏项内容，玩家必须说明 contribution + omission + add request，语言直接决定工作是否进入正式记录。
provenance.frequency_basis: 需求金字塔第 4 层(尊重)。必需槽位核心词 change#113 / wrote#121 / numbers#127 / put#139 / report#166 / name#206 / record#344 / add#414 / section#668 均在 NGSL 前七百,correct#1032 刚出首千;难度在一次交流里组织「完成了什么 + 汇总漏了 + 请补入」三个意思单元，而非要求语法完美。
